prerequisites: Elementary knowledge of Mechatronics is desirable, though not essential.
Basic notions of Linear Algebra are advisable.
Basic notions of Differential and Integral Calculus are advisable.
Basic notions of Numerical Methods are advisable.
Basic notions of Electrical Technology are advisable.
Basic notions of Computer Fundamentals are advisable.

learning_outcomes.text: The importance of signal conditioning in Electronics.
The use of microcontrollers in mechatronic and embedded systems.
Develop a simple mechatronic project: from its design to its final implementation.

assessment_rules: To pass "Mechatronic Design I", students must pass both local Master's courses. The final grade is calculated as 0.75 * DISP + 0.25 * 1GdL. It is mandatory to pass both local courses; otherwise, the final grade will be 'Fail', and the numerical grade will be the weighted average or 4.0 (whichever is lower). If a student does not attend all defined exams, the final grade will be 'Not Presented (NP)' or 'Fail' depending on attendance, with participation in at least 50% of activities requiring a grade.
